summary: Reproduced the DSpark confidence-head reshape failure when runtime gamma differs from checkpoint gamma. The planner now passes runtime gamma to DeepseekV4ForCausalLMDSpark.compute_confidence, which uses it consistently for the hidden-state reshape and Markov context while preserving checkpoint gamma as the direct-call default.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: runtime gamma 7 with checkpoint gamma 5 raised RuntimeError while reshaping 56 elements to [2, 5, -1]. Two boundary tests passed. Raw output: reports/j-10e383f4dd2e/failing-before.txt

10 tests passed, covering runtime override propagation, checkpoint-default behavior, the generic confidence path, and existing DSpark argument/default behavior. Raw output: reports/j-10e383f4dd2e/passing-after.txt

On the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950, checkpoint gamma 5 and runtime gamma 7 produced shape [2, 7] and matched an independently constructed PyTorch reference exactly (max absolute error 0.0; checksum 13.518386841). Raw output: reports/j-10e383f4dd2e/gpu-runtime-gamma.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: The runtime-gamma confidence path executed on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 using ROCm PyTorch. Device inventory is in reports/j-10e383f4dd2e/gpu-info.txt and numerical output is in reports/j-10e383f4dd2e/gpu-runtime-gamma.txt.

remaining_limitations: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark model weights were not available, so full model loading and CUDA/HIP graph capture were not reproduced.
The reported 4x NVIDIA H20 TP4/DP4 deployment could not be reproduced with the assigned single AMD gfx950 GPU.
The GPU fixture validates the affected planner/model confidence computation and numerical result, not full-model semantic accuracy or distributed execution.
